verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's reliability docs describe configurable fallbacks. After num_retries a failing call moves to another model group (e.g. fallbacks=["gpt-3.5-turbo"]), and specialized content_policy_fallbacks are also documented. The Router adds cooldowns, timeouts and retries across deployments and providers. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that fallback works in production (the community evidence only cites the maintainers' motivation for reliable model switching).
